title: Buns and Jam
lines: Mom had a bag of buns.
"Let us have a bit," said Gus.
Bud digs in the bag. He got a bun and a nut.
Gus had jam on his bun. "It is hot," said Mom.
Bud and Gus sit on a log.
A pup runs up to Bud.
Bud lets him have a bit of bun.
The pup wags and hops. Gus and Bud hug the pup.
